# Integration Checklist: Claude/Codex Cutover and Universal Install Release Gate

**Purpose**: Validate that XPLAT-008 integration requirements keep active Claude/Codex surfaces, generated payloads, release gates, public guidance, and docs aligned on one installed Python runner path.
**Created**: 2026-07-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist integration` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Active Runtime Surface Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are Claude and Codex skills, agents, hooks, install guidance, generated payload files, release gates, public docs, archive/provenance text, CI dispatch glue, and upstream Spec Kit helpers all classified by active installed-runtime scope? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Plan Slice 1]
- [x] CHK002 Are active installed-runtime surfaces required to use the same argv-style Python runner invocation rather than shell-only helpers? [Consistency, Spec FR-002, Plan Constraints]
- [x] CHK003 Are prohibited active-runtime dependencies defined consistently across source surfaces, generated payloads, install guidance, and release gates? [Consistency, Spec FR-003/FR-004, Plan Slice 1]
- [x] CHK004 Are allowed exceptions for archive/provenance text, CI dispatch glue, and upstream generated helpers clearly separated from active installed-runtime requirements? [Clarity, Spec FR-005, Plan Slice 1]

## Runner Invocation Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Is interpreter discovery specified consistently for Windows, macOS, and Linux before invoking `-m speckit_pro_runner`? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, Plan Technical Decisions]
- [x] CHK006 Are stdin/stdout JSON envelope expectations and stderr diagnostic handling defined for active installed surfaces? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, Plan Constraints]
- [x] CHK007 Are active guards required to fail when shell parsing, redirection, Unix-only paths, or `jq` return to active installed-runtime paths? [Measurability, Spec FR-004, SC-002, Plan Testing]
- [x] CHK008 Are first-use scaffold, status, and autopilot dry-run journeys tied to the same installed runner path across Claude and Codex? [Coverage, Spec US1, SC-001, Plan Summary]

## Source-To-Dist Payload Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Is the expected Claude payload inventory source-derived and inclusive of manifest, skills, agents, hooks, install guidance, runner package, version metadata, and trust records? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, Plan Slice 2]
- [x] CHK010 Is the expected Codex payload inventory source-derived and inclusive of manifest, normalized skills, agents, hooks, install guidance, runner package, version metadata, and trust records? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, Plan Slice 2]
- [x] CHK011 Are required source-to-dist transforms such as guard stripping, Codex overlays, path rewrites, and manifest path normalization documented for payload comparison? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications, Plan Technical Decisions]
- [x] CHK012 Are payload gates required to fail on missing, stale, extra, changed, path-leaking, or non-deterministic generated payload files? [Measurability, Spec FR-008, Plan Slice 2]

## Release Gate And Evidence Integration

- [x] CHK013 Are release-readiness blockers aligned across active shell dependency scans, payload completeness, bundled agents, version metadata, public claim safety, UAT evidence, and repair claims? [Consistency, Spec FR-019, SC-005, Plan Technical Decisions]
- [x] CHK014 Are generated payload completeness results explicitly accepted as evidence for the public release gate only after both Claude and Codex payloads pass? [Traceability, Spec US2, SC-003, Plan Slice 2]
- [x] CHK015 Are native UAT, update, and repair evidence requirements integrated with release-readiness instead of relying on generic runbook placeholders? [Completeness, Spec FR-012/FR-014, Plan Slice 3]
- [x] CHK016 Are PR packet traceability requirements defined so reviewers can follow each major requirement to changed files and verification evidence? [Traceability, Spec FR-020, SC-008, Plan PR Review Packet Source]

## Public Guidance Alignment

- [x] CHK017 Are root and plugin README install/update guidance surfaces explicitly included in the public guidance update scope alongside docs-site pages and release notes? [Completeness, Workflow Integration Prompt, Spec FR-009/FR-011, Plan Declared File Operations]
- [x] CHK018 Are public docs and release notes constrained to implemented and UAT-backed support claims without unsupported cryptographic guarantees? [Consistency, Spec FR-011, SC-007, Plan Slice 2]
- [x] CHK019 Are install, first-run, troubleshooting, and trust docs required to avoid presenting Bash, Git Bash, WSL, PowerShell-specific command language, or `jq` as installed-plugin prerequisites? [Coverage, Spec FR-009/FR-010, Plan Declared File Operations]
- [x] CHK020 Is generated payload behavior required to match source docs and release-readiness evidence rather than relying on current `dist/**` as the source of truth? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, Plan Payload Contract]
